question: A group of people consists of men, women and children. Among them, 20% are men, 50% are women and the rest are children, and their average weights are 45 kg, 60 kg and 20 kg, respectively. The average weight (in kg) of the group is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Men : Women : Children** = 20 : 50 : (100 − 70) = 2 : 5 : 3.

Average weight = [(2 × 45) + (5 × 60) + (3 × 20)] ÷ (2 + 5 + 3)

Average weight = [90 + 300 + 60] ÷ 10 = 450 ÷ 10 = 45 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 45 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of **Men** = 20%, **Women** = 50%, **Children** = 30%

Average weight of **Men** = 45 kg, **Women** = 60 kg, **Children** = 20 kg

**Formula Used:**

Total Weight = (Average Weight × Number of People)

Average Weight of Group = Total Weight of all ÷ Total Number of People

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12dffd956ffc5c6cbef8406521929dad3386a991fea908391464d0fd95fe0a94.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **total number** of people in the group be 100.

⇒ Number of **Men** = 20, **Women** = 50, **Children** = 100 − (20 + 50) = 30.

⇒ Total weight of **Men** = 20 × 45 = 900 kg.

⇒ Total weight of **Women** = 50 × 60 = 3000 kg.

⇒ Total weight of **Children** = 30 × 20 = 600 kg.

⇒ Total weight of the **group** = 900 + 3000 + 600 = 4500 kg.

⇒ Average weight of the **group** = 4500 ÷ 100 = 45 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 45 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

Used when different groups have different sizes and averages: Avg = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Deviation Method

Assume an average (say 40) and calculate net deviation: Total deviation = [Σ(Actual − Assumed) × Weight]. Avg = Assumed + (Total Deviation ÷ Total Weight).

Ratio Simplification

In problems involving **percentages**, always simplify the quantities into the smallest possible **ratios** to reduce calculation time.</p
